facts.text: Six Senses AMAALA is a village-inspired resort that blends its suites, villas and branded residences into the natural terrain.
facts.excerpt: Six Senses AMAALA unfolds as a village-inspired resort that blends 100 suites and villas and 25 branded residences into the natural terrain

facts.text: The clifftop Mesa crowns the resort, framed by beaches, a mangrove-fringed lagoon and coral reefs.
facts.excerpt: The striking clifftop Mesa crowns the resort extending a warm welcome framed by beaches, a mangrove-fringed lagoon, and pristine coral reefs.

facts.text: Accommodation is inspired by traditional Saudi coastal villages and built with locally sourced materials.
facts.excerpt: Inspired by traditional Saudi coastal villages, our accommodations are built with locally sourced materials

facts.text: Guests choose from pool suites, villas with one to four bedrooms, and branded residences.
facts.excerpt: Choose from pool suites or villas with one to four bedrooms, and branded residences that blend into the natural landforms.

facts.text: Interiors feature calming tones, natural wood and layered textiles.
facts.excerpt: Interiors feature calming tones, natural wood and layered textiles

facts.text: The spa is a desert oasis sheltered between sloping walls, with lush vegetation, pools and waterfalls.
facts.excerpt: Welcome to a hidden desert oasis sheltered between sloping walls, with lush vegetation, pools, and waterfalls creating a sense of refuge.

facts.text: Spa treatment rooms open onto private terraces, and the spa has a Watsu pool and a sound dome.
facts.excerpt: Treatment rooms open onto private terraces while the Watsu pool and sound dome offer calming sensory experiences.

facts.text: The Longevity Center features recovery treatments, and separate male and female thermal areas include saunas, a salt room and vitality pools.
facts.excerpt: The Longevity Center features cutting-edge recovery and separate male and female thermal areas include saunas, a salt room, and vitality pools.

facts.text: Wellness includes signature massages, hammam rituals, family treatments, daily yoga and fitness classes, and multi-day programs.
facts.excerpt: From signature massages, hammam rituals and family treatments to daily yoga and fitness classes and multi-day programs

facts.text: Soraya, the signature dinner restaurant atop the Mesa, has panoramic bay views and blends Japanese and Latin American cooking with Red Sea produce.
facts.excerpt: Our signature dinner restaurant perched atop the Mesa with panoramic bay views. Japanese precision meets Latin American passion through the bounty of the Red Sea.

facts.text: The non-alcoholic beverage program features fermented drinks, botanical infusions and probiotic tonics.
facts.excerpt: Our pioneering non-alcoholic beverage program features fermented drinks, botanical infusions, and probiotic tonics.

facts.text: AMAALA spans over 1,600 square miles (4,144 square kilometers) of protected coastline on Saudi Arabia's Red Sea.
facts.excerpt: AMAALA spans over 1,600 square miles (4,144 square kilometers) of protected coastline on Saudi Arabia's Red Sea.

facts.text: The Corallium Marine Life Institute offers marine exhibits, and the AMAALA Yacht Club hosts a sailing community.
facts.excerpt: The Corallium Marine Life Institute offers marine exhibits, while the AMAALA Yacht Club hosts a vibrant sailing community, all powered by renewable energy.

facts.text: Experiences range from desert adventures to reefs.
facts.excerpt: Take in the beauty around you, from desert adventures to thriving reefs.
